thread:
Olivia Chen: Quick heads-up — we're rolling Hosted Multimodal Streams (multistream-v1) to GA next week (Mon Apr 4). This is the new streaming + tool-calling endpoint that accepts image+text inputs and supports our compact cost mode. TL;DR: general availability, SDKs updated, migration path below. :tada:

Ava Patel: Nice! A few ops details: new endpoint is `/v2/generate/streaming` with `model=multistream-v1`. Old `/v1/stream` will be kept for 90 days then deprecated. Please update clients to the SDKs we pushed yesterday.

Ava Patel: Example curl (streaming + tool call hints):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"multistream-v1","input":[{"type":"text","text":"Summarize the image"},{"type":"image","url":"https://.../img.jpg"}],"stream":true}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate/streaming
```

Liam O'Connor: Ops notes: canary starts tonight at 22:00 UTC (10% -> 50% -> 100% over 3h if no alerts). SLO target: p50 < 120ms token, p95 < 900ms. Watch `mms-latency` and `mms-errors`. I'm enabling auto-fallback to `gpt-lite-compat` for timeouts.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated for multistream-v1 — rollout ID `roll-22345-x1`. Stage: 10% traffic (ETA 30m). Logs: https://internal.deploys/roll-22345-x1

Maya - PM: Customer comms: We'll announce GA in the Monday partner update and add a migration guide for customers on older streaming integrations. Action: @Ava please confirm SDK changelog + migration snippet by EOD Fri.

DocsBot: Docs published: https://docs.redwood.ai/api/multistream-v1 (migration guide, SDK snippets, and known limitations).

Ava Patel: Migration snippet for Python (minimal adapter):
```
# old: client.stream("/v1/stream", model="stream-lite")
client.generate_streaming(model="multistream-v1", inputs=[...], stream=True)
```
Old endpoints will return a deprecation header `x-redwood-deprecate: v1-stream;expires=90d`.

Olivia Chen: Enterprise/Dedicated note: Dedicated customers can pin a specific model artifact; Private control planes will see the same endpoint when we push the agent update next week. No forced changes on their side if they keep pinned versions.

Liam O'Connor: Runbook links: Incident/runbooks -> `mms-fallback` and `mms-memory-leak` checks. Paging: oncall -> `eng-oncall` if error rate > 2% for 15m.

deploy-bot: Canary stage completed: 10% -> 50% (no critical alerts). Moving to 100% traffic in 45m. :rocket:

Olivia Chen: Thanks team. After 100% rollout and a 24h stability window we'll publish a customer-facing blog & migration webinar invite. @Maya can you schedule the webinar?

Maya - PM: On it — will schedule Wed next week and draft slides with @Ava.

Liam O'Connor: Monitoring dashboards updated: `Prod / multistream-v1 / Overview`. Alerting thresholds in the runbook.

Olivia Chen: Final callout — watch for any edge cases with tool-calls + large images (we've throttled large-image decoding by default). Report anything odd here. :eyes:
